description: Irstea publishes DamaGIS, a geodatabase of local flood damage in southern France. The inspected deposit contains 729 damage entries associated with 23 floods reported since 2011. An EVENT feature class stores event polygons, while a DAMAGE feature class stores individual damage points. Sources include field observations, news reports and social media, with a simplified severity assessment intended to support comparisons. The public ZIP supplies three GIS formats for QGIS and MapInfo use, free under CC-BY-4.0. Exact temporal completeness and positional accuracy are not established by the landing metadata. A limitation is that uneven reporting and simplified severity categories constrain direct interpretation as insured losses or engineering damage ratios. The observations can support calibration or validation of infrastructure flood-damage simulations. DamaGIS complements hydraulic inundation maps by supplying reported consequences at individual locations, not additional simulated water depths.
